question: Who among the following was regarded as the Father of Modern Dance, in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uday Shankar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Uday Shankar is **regarded as **the **Father of Modern Dance in India.**
 
• Uday Shankar was an** Indian dancer and choreographer**
 
• He **fused European theatrical techniques** with Indian classical dance to create a unique style.
 
• His dance innovation influenced India, Europe, and the US in the 1920s and 1930s.
 
• In 1938, Uday Shankar founded the Uday Shankar India Culture Centre in __Almora, Uttaranchal (now Uttarakhand).
 
• Together with his brother, the sitarist Ravi Shankar, he explored classical and folk dance 
 
• In 1962, he was awarded by Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy for Music, Dance and Drama.
 
• In 1971, the Govt. of India, awarded him its second highest civilian award the Padma Vibhushan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Pankaj Charan Das**

 
 
• **​**Pankaj Charan Das was a renowned Odissi dancer, choreographer, and teacher 
 
• He played a significant role in the revival and popularization of Odissi during the 20th century.'.
 
• He received Padma Shri, Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for Dance - Odissi.
 
 
 
• **Kunchu Kurup**
 
 
• Kunchu Kurup is **widely recognised** for the **dance form of Kathakali**
 
• It** originates** from the** southern Indian state of Kerala.**
 
• The dance form is characterised by** elaborate costumes, intricate makeup, and exaggerated facial expressions and gestures.**
 
 
 
• **Raja Reddy****​**
 
 
• Raja Reddy is an **Indian Kuchipudi dancer, guru and choreographer**
 
• They founded and run the Natya Tarangini Institute of Kuchipudi Dance in New Delhi.
 
• For their services to the field of arts, the Government of India has conferred on them the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan awards.
 
• Kuchipudi is indigenous to the state of Andhra Pradesh.
